question: Which of the following dances is performed by women from the countryside villages of Malwa region in Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __Matki__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Matki:

 
 
• It is a community dance of Malwa in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The dancers move rhythmically to the beating of a drum, locally called Matki.
 
• It is Initiated by a lone woman locally called Jhela.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• Padyani is a ritualistic dance form performed in the Yakshagana tradition of Karnataka.
 
• Thirayattam is a ritualistic dance form performed in Kerala during temple festivals.
 
• Dandia Raas is a popular folk dance form from Gujarat, where men and women dance with sticks in their hands.
